name: mcp-logger
description: Log meals and review nutrition, energy balance and body measurements in your private FitnessTrackr account.

interface.longDescription: Log meals and drinks, search UK and branded foods, review nutrition and body measurements, and manage personal macro targets and opt-in reminders. Connect your FitnessTrackr account securely using OAuth. Food and wearable energy values are estimates. Free personal project hosted in the UK.
